From bb3f21edc7056cdf44a7f7bd7ba65af40741838c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kohei Enju <kohei@enjuk.jp>
Date: Sun, 1 Feb 2026 14:14:00 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] ice: ptp: don't WARN when controlling PF is unavailable

In VFIO passthrough setups, it is possible to pass through only a PF
which doesn't own the source timer. In that case the PTP controlling PF
(adapter->ctrl_pf) is never initialized in the VM, so ice_get_ctrl_ptp()
returns NULL and triggers WARN_ON() in ice_ptp_setup_pf().

Since this is an expected behavior in that configuration, replace
WARN_ON() with an informational message and return -EOPNOTSUPP.

Fixes: e800654e85b5 ("ice: Use ice_adapter for PTP shared data instead of auxdev")
Signed-off-by: Kohei Enju <kohei@enjuk.jp>
Reviewed-by: Aleksandr Loktionov <aleksandr.loktionov@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Nguyen <anthony.l.nguyen@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ptp.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ptp.c
index 094e96219f45..a3c5f0a5e09b 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ptp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ptp.c
@@ -3080,7 +3080,13 @@ static int ice_ptp_setup_pf(struct ice_pf *pf)
 	struct ice_ptp *ctrl_ptp = ice_get_ctrl_ptp(pf);
 	struct ice_ptp *ptp = &pf->ptp;
 
-	if (WARN_ON(!ctrl_ptp) || pf->hw.mac_type == ICE_MAC_UNKNOWN)
+	if (!ctrl_ptp) {
+		dev_info(ice_pf_to_dev(pf),
+			 "PTP unavailable: no controlling PF\n");
+		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
+	}
+
+	if (pf->hw.mac_type == ICE_MAC_UNKNOWN)
 		return -ENODEV;
 
 	INIT_LIST_HEAD(&ptp->port.list_node);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### Files Changed

**`drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ptp.c`**  
- Modified function `ice_ptp_setup_pf`:
  - Replaced `WARN_ON(!ctrl_ptp)` with an explicit conditional check.
  - When `ctrl_ptp` is `NULL` (i.e., the controlling PF for PTP is unavailable), the code now logs an informational message (`dev_info`) indicating "PTP unavailable: no controlling PF" and returns `-EOPNOTSUPP`.
  - The subsequent check for `ICE_MAC_UNKNOWN` (which returns `-ENODEV`) remains unchanged and is now logically separate from the `ctrl_ptp` check.

### Relationships Between Changes

- The change is confined to a single function (`ice_ptp_setup_pf`) in one file.
- The previous logic combined the `ctrl_ptp` and `MAC_UNKNOWN` checks inside a single `if` with a `WARN_ON`. The patch splits these into two independent checks:
  1. If `ctrl_ptp` is missing (expected in VFIO passthrough scenarios where the controlling PF is not present), the function gracefully returns `-EOPNOTSUPP` with an informative message, avoiding a kernel warning.
  2. If the MAC type is unknown, the function returns `-ENODEV` as before.
- The patch fixes a bug where an unsupported but valid configuration (no controlling PF in a VFIO passthrough VM) triggered an unnecessary `WARN_ON`, improving robustness and user-friendliness.

Here is the commit message:
ice: ptp: don't WARN when controlling PF is unavailable

In VFIO passthrough setups, it is possible to pass through only a PF
which doesn't own the source timer. In that case the PTP controlling PF
(adapter->ctrl_pf) is never initialized in the VM, so ice_get_ctrl_ptp()
returns NULL and triggers WARN_ON() in ice_ptp_setup_pf().

Since this is an expected behavior in that configuration, replace
WARN_ON() with an informational message and return -EOPNOTSUPP.

Fixes: e800654e85b5 ("ice: Use ice_adapter for PTP shared data instead of auxdev")
Signed-off-by: Kohei Enju <kohei@enjuk.jp>
Reviewed-by: Aleksandr Loktionov <aleksandr.loktionov@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Nguyen <anthony.l.nguyen@intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The code used `WARN_ON(!ctrl_ptp)` to assert that the controlling PF for PTP is always present. However, in VFIO passthrough setups where only a PF without the source timer is passed through, the controlling PF (`adapter->ctrl_pf`) is never initialized in the VM, causing `ice_get_ctrl_ptp()` to return NULL. This triggers an unnecessary kernel warning, even though the behavior is expected in that configuration. The fix replaces the warning with a graceful error return and an informational message.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int ice_ptp_setup_pf(struct ice_pf *pf)
 {
 	struct ice_ptp *ctrl_ptp = ice_get_ctrl_ptp(pf);
 	struct ice_ptp *ptp = &pf->ptp;
 
-	if (WARN_ON(!ctrl_ptp) || pf->hw.mac_type == ICE_MAC_UNKNOWN)
+	if (!ctrl_ptp) {
+		dev_info(ice_pf_to_dev(pf),
+			 "PTP unavailable: no controlling PF\n");
+		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
+	}
+
+	if (pf->hw.mac_type == ICE_MAC_UNKNOWN)
 		return -ENODEV;
 
 	INIT_LIST_HEAD(&ptp->port.list_node);
 	mutex_lock(&pf->adapter->ports.lock);
 
 	list_add(&ptp->port.list_node,
 		 &pf->adapter->ports.ports);
 	mutex_unlock(&pf->adapter->ports.lock);
 
 	return 0;
 }
